title: Verified results corpus for the pre-registered origination competition

feed.one_url_per_game: official nfl.com game centre, carried on the row

pre_registered_2026.peer_reconciliation: 192/192 identity checks passed in that file

extension.note: the week-10 game source 2 could not settle on 11-17

policy: Union of the stored official reads, with an explicit alias table and a duplicate audit. No value is fetched, inferred, averaged or re-typed this session. A score disagreement between two sources would exclude the game from scoring and appear on the flagged page; there were none.

assertions: official nfl.com URL on every row: a game-centre page or the official week schedule page (granularity recorded per row)
unique (season, week, away, home) after alias normalisation
integer non-negative scores; total == away + home; margin == home - away
winner consistent with margin; ties recorded
union game count equals the count implied by official standings
sum(PF) == sum(PA) and corpus points == sum(PF) in the standings file

cross_source_audit.reading: two independent stored reads of the same official pages agree on every overlapping score. That is corroboration between sessions; it is not independent of the publisher.
